prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada in the year that the 1965 winner of the Best New Artist Grammy Award made their first appearance on US television?
answer:
The 1965 Best New Artist Grammy was won by **The Beatles**. Their first U.S. television appearance was in **1964**, when **Lester B. Pearson** was Prime Minister of Canada.

**Answer: Lester B. Pearson.**
